newspaper.headline: Nusa Digital Starts an AI Project
newspaper.lead: PT Nusa Digital's AI team has started training models for several services. The data team must make sure the training data is fair and safe.

tip.title: Tip: AI Can Make Things Up
tip.text: AI assistants sometimes cite official-sounding sources that do not exist. Check before quoting.

sources: NIST — AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)

impact.good: Clean charity run data meant the winners were announced without complaints.
impact.mixed: The charity run announcement had to be corrected because of some duplicates.
impact.bad: The announced donation total turned out wrong. The committee apologised to participants.

newspaper.classified: WANTED: Balanced training data. Lopsided data need not apply.

boss.title: AI Launch
boss.intro: The AI team wants to launch this afternoon! One query and two AI decisions must be done first.
